buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Technical compliance 1. The bidder shall submit a duly signed and stamped technical compliance sheet against each sp ecification mentioned in the bid. 2. The bidder shall provide the technical datasheet of the proposed board, printing material and m ounting arrangement. 3. Any deviation from the specified technical parameters shall be clearly disclosed. Undisclosed de viations may be treated as non-compliance. 4. The bidder shall ensure that the supplied signage boards are free from printing defects, bubbles , wrinkles, peeling, fading and physical damage at the time of delivery. B. Quality assurance 5. The bidder shall provide a digital artwork proof for approval before commencement of bulk print ing. 6. The bidder shall ensure consistent colour reproduction and legibility throughout the supplied quantity. 7. The bidder shall replace defective or damaged boards at no additional cost to the buyer. 8. The mounting structure shall be sufficiently rigid and protected against corrosion for the intende d outdo or application. C. Delivery and installation 9. The bidder shall be responsible for transportation, unloading, mounting and installation at the designate d locations.

10. All labour, tools, fasteners and installation-related expenses shall be included in the quoted price. 11. The bidder shall ensure that the installation does not damage the existing structure or surrounding pro perty. 12. Final acceptance shall be subject to verification of dimensions, material, printing quality and installatio n by purchase committe. D. The seller must have prior experience in the supply and installation of signage and hoardings in hill y/m ountainous terrain. The seller shall be required to showcase and/or submit documentary proof of such exp erience likr CRAC or Client Certificate. E. The tender is invited for supply and complete onsite installation of the following items at the location(s) specified by the buyer/consignee. 1) Sign board - 20 nos (supply and installation required) 2) Sign Boards (Hoarding) - 5 nos (supply and installation required) F. CA-certified Annual Turnover Certificate for the last 3 financial years is required to prove turnover. G. All claims pertaining to MSE status shall be duly verified through the GeM portal. Make in India, and Lo cal Content, as required under the GeM Order and the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) O rder, shall be duly verified either through the GeM portal or by the concerned competent authority. Unveri fied claims shall not be considered for extending the benefits of applicable procurement preferences. H. Bidders are required to accept all the terms and conditions mentioned by buyer on their letterhead. . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
